import datetime, hashlib, json, os, shutil, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
stage = root / '.local/step07/fix-round2/final'
stage.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
source = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
env = {**os.environ, 'PATH': '<EXISTING_NODE_22_21_1_BIN>:' + os.environ['PATH'], 'API_PORT': '4376', 'WEB_PORT': '5276', 'INTEGRATION_API_PORT': '4376', 'STEP07_TEST_API_PORT': '4376', 'MZ_CORE_PATH': '<LOCAL_PINNED_NATIVE_CORE>'}
commands = [('check', ['pnpm', 'check'], {}), ('db-migrate', ['pnpm', 'db:migrate'], {}), ('step07', ['pnpm', 'test:step07'], {}), ('api-integration', ['pnpm', 'test:integration'], {}), ('dev-privacy', ['pnpm', 'test:dev-privacy'], {}), ('browser-production', ['pnpm', 'test:e2e'], {}), ('browser-development', ['pnpm', 'test:e2e'], {'E2E_MODE': 'dev'}), ('engineering', ['pnpm', 'build:step07'], {}), ('pack-sample', ['pnpm', 'build:pack-sample'], {})]
for label, args, extra in commands:
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip() == source
    assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], text=True).strip()
    progress = root / '.local/step07/coding-progress.json'
    j = json.loads(progress.read_text()); j.update(phase='R1_BOUND_' + label.upper(), updatedAtUtc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat())
    progress.write_text(json.dumps(j, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
    started = time.time(); log = stage / (label + '.log')
    with log.open('w') as stream:
        result = subprocess.run(args, env={**env, **extra}, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    entry = {'label': label, 'args': args, 'sourceSHA': source, 'env': {'API_PORT': '4376', 'WEB_PORT': '5276', 'INTEGRATION_API_PORT': '4376', 'STEP07_TEST_API_PORT': '4376', **extra, 'MZ_CORE_PATH': 'LOCAL_PINNED_NATIVE_CORE_SHA4ad828ae'}, 'exitCode': result.returncode, 'durationSeconds': round(time.time() - started, 2), 'log': str(log.relative_to(root)), 'logSha256': hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    with (stage / 'commands.jsonl').open('a') as stream: stream.write(json.dumps(entry) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({'label': label, 'exitCode': result.returncode, 'seconds': entry['durationSeconds']}), flush=True)
    if result.returncode: raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
    if label.startswith('browser-'):
        mode = 'dev' if label.endswith('development') else 'production'
        shutil.copytree(root / '.local/step07/browser' / mode, stage / ('browser-' + mode))
print('FROZEN_R1_CANDIDATE_PRIMARY_CHECKS_COMPLETE', flush=True)
